source.name: USDA MyPlate Kitchen
source.credit: Food Hero, Oregon State University Cooperative Extension Service

ingredients.name: cauliflower rice, grated or finely chopped, about half a medium head

steps.instruction: Mix 2 cups of cauliflower rice, 1 egg and 3 tablespoons of flour in a medium bowl.
Mix in 1/4 cup of grated cheddar cheese and 1/4 teaspoon of salt.
Press the mixture into about 15 small balls or logs.
Put the tots on the baking sheet with space between each one.
Bake for 20 minutes, until cooked through.
For extra crispy tots, broil them for 2 more minutes.
steps.spoken: For extra crispy tots, broil them for 2 more minutes. Watch closely so they do not burn.
